grading.japanese: NFKC + punctuation/spacing normalization + stored natural alternatives; no semantic fuzzy guessing.
grading.english: NFKC + stored natural alternatives + very small typo-distance tolerance.
grading.particles: Exact normalized match against one or more context-valid answers.

romaji: Curated per sentence frame and lexicon; hidden by default and revealed only on request. EN to JP translation does not reveal romaji before answering because it would expose the Japanese answer.
content: Curated level-specific grammar frames with compatible lexicons; Sakura study-support levels, not official JLPT sentence classifications.
loading: Each level bank is fetched only when the new quiz is opened.
